label: Classes
description: Every class as cards, then questions.

settings.heading: Classes
settings.standfirst: Twelve classes, coached on every session. Start anywhere: the coach scales it to you.

settings.question: Do I need to be fit already?
settings.answer: No. Every class is scaled to you by the coach, and most people start with Strength Foundations.

settings.question: How do I book?
settings.answer: Book on the timetable or at the desk. Classes cap at sixteen, small-group sessions at six.

settings.question: What should I bring?
settings.answer: Trainers with a flat sole, a water bottle and a towel. We have chalk, belts and lockers.

settings.question: Can I try before I join?
settings.answer: Yes. Your first class is free on every plan; tell us which one and a coach will meet you at the door.
